newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Absa buys control of offshore Stonehage.
newsitem.headline: Absa buys control of offshore Stonehage.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd (Absa) announced on Tuesday it had acquired a controlling interest in the Stonehage Group, an international trust and asset management group with offices in the United Kingdom and Switzerland.
"This acquisition enables Absa to complete the establishment of Absa Offshore in Jersey," the group said.
Absa announced on Monday it was considering an international equity offering to international investors, as previously notified to shareholders.
Absa said it intended to use the proceeds of any such offering to refinance and expand its international operations.
Both Stonehage and Absa Offshore will be held under a newly-established Jersey holding company.

Stonehage will continue to be managed by existing directors as part of an independent operation. The same executive team will manage Absa Offshore and assist in the development of Absa's South African private banking initiative.

Absa executive director Louw van Wyk said the acquisition, following close on the heels of the group's recent joint venture announcement with France's Banque Cortal, forms part of Absa's strategy to further strengthen its international operations.

"Stonehage is a leading, well-established offshore player with a strong client base and developed infrastructure. Together with the formation of Absa Offshore (Jersey) we can now offer clients a range of offshore investment options and other services of the highest quality," van Wyk said.
He said Absa would launch the multi-manager Absa Offshore Select Fund in July.
Stonehage was established in 1976 and has funds in excess of $1 billion under management.
